app.name: Decidely
input.title: Your options
input.description: Describe the decision you're weighing up, then name the two options you're comparing.
input.meta.title: Add your options — Decidely
input.meta.description: Start by listing the options you want to compare.
input.decisionPlaceholder: e.g. Should I take the remote job or stay in my current role?
confirm.title: Confirm categories
confirm.description: Check the categories that matter for this decision, then acknowledge each wellbeing prompt.
confirm.meta.title: Confirm your categories — Decidely
confirm.meta.description: Review the categories that apply to your decision before scoring.
confirm.detectedHint: These are auto-detected for now — you can refine them later.
confirm.wellbeingHint: Tap each row to acknowledge it.
rating.title: Rate each option
rating.description: Score how well each option performs on what matters.
rating.meta.title: Rate your options — Decidely
rating.meta.description: Score each option against your criteria.
rating.markerHint: Tap a marker to select it, then drag to set its score. Each option is set separately.
rating.empty: No categories were marked relevant. Go back and confirm your categories.
weighting.title: Set the weights
weighting.description: Decide how much each criterion counts towards the result.
weighting.meta.title: Weight your criteria — Decidely
weighting.meta.description: Choose how much each criterion matters.
weighting.question: How much does this matter overall?
weighting.empty: No categories were marked relevant. Go back and confirm your categories.
dealbreakers.title: Dealbreaker check
dealbreakers.description: Flag anything that rules an option out completely.
dealbreakers.meta.title: Dealbreaker check — Decidely
dealbreakers.meta.description: Mark the conditions that disqualify an option.
dealbreakers.gatePrompt: Before you decide — does anything here outweigh the score?
dealbreakers.newRound: Take a new round of evaluation
report.title: Your report
report.description: Here's how your options stack up.
report.meta.title: Your decision report — Decidely
report.meta.description: See the ranked result of your decision.
